notes: Wave B: Gloop grows up (Baby, Kid, Teen, Grown-up) as you play. Day and night follow your clock, with a nightlight and a sleepier Gloop at night. Critters: butterflies and ladybugs for Gloop to chase. Two new games: Gloop Goal (build a path to the flag) and a weekly boss (Big Rubber Duck, Grumpy Thundercloud or Robo-Crate). 12 collectibles drop from games, including two that unlock a Prism skin and Cosmic eyes. The Shop now opens on Tools, shown as a grid.
